description: Revisit QKV unions after 117 cross-tensor reductions
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,479 parameters at 99.200000%, a +0.200000-point margin. There have been 84 prior macro-attempts and 674 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0185/micro-0002 at 1,479/99.20%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0186/micro-0001, where a normalization-bias union scored 98.08%. The most recent QKV band ended in attempt-0165 after pair 571/651 scored 98.99%; that pair and all earlier sensitive QKV pairs are excluded. Hypothesis: 117 retained reductions in FF, token, and normalization tensors plus recovered margin materially changed residual routing enough to reopen QKV compression. The helper adds one minimum-difference eligible QKV union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than another normalization variant because it retests a high-capacity tensor only after materially changed conditions.
summary: The QKV revisit reached its declared 20-trial cap with all 20 ordered unions qualifying. The retained frontier moved from 1,479 to 1,459 parameters; no scored discards or errors occurred. Compute used 20 official migrations/verifications over about 24m20s. Stop reason: hard micro-trial cap, not a measured failure boundary. This confirms cross-tensor compression materially reopened QKV redundancy.
